goals.text: The repository has the uv-monorepo shape (a workspace root that installs nothing, `packages/kmctl` and `packages/kmaudit` each a full package, one root `uv.lock`), `uv run pytest` at the root still runs every test, and the release workflows keep building, checking and publishing kmctl from its new folder until `release-per-package` reworks them
Users install kmctl from post-move tags through `#subdirectory=packages/kmctl`, and projects pinned to v0.12.1 or older keep running their pin
The knowledge bundle and rules describe the tree as it now is, and an ADR records the move

outcomes.change: The root is a workspace root that installs nothing, kmctl builds, tests and releases from packages/kmctl
outcomes.checked_by: `uv sync` then `uv run kmctl --version` at the root prints `apm/apm.yml`'s version; `uv build --package kmctl` (wheel built from the sdist) and `uv build --wheel --package kmctl` both give a wheel at that version with `_skills`, `_agents` and `_rules` that `scripts/check_wheel.py` and `scripts/smoke_wheel.py` accept; the skills, agents and rules tests pass against the editable install, where `_skills`, `_agents` and `_rules` do not exist (the source-tree fallbacks find `apm/` at the root); `uv run pytest --collect-only` at the root selects 1407 tests (876 under `packages/kmctl/tests`, 276 under `tests/`, 255 under `packages/kmaudit/tests`) and `uv run pytest` passes; `tests/scripts/test_workflows.py` pins `uv build --package kmctl` and the check_wheel pyproject path in both release workflows, and ci.yml's starter job runs `new:packages/kmctl/tests/test_starter.py` (ci-per-package later splits the rest of ci.yml); the `kmctl-check` hook installs and runs from a post-move commit in another repository (the hook test in the docs front matter tests); the action installs kmctl from `packages/kmctl` and the `knowledge` CI job (`uses: ./`) passes; the starter renders `kmctl_src` with the fragment for a newer `kmctl_ref` and without it for v0.12.1, and `new:packages/kmctl/tests/test_starter.py -m integration` bootstraps from a `file://` clone; the `tree_repo` fixture runs `scripts/release.py set` on its copy at a test-only version one minor past `apm/apm.yml`'s and tags that commit at it, and the starter bootstrap integration test passes against it (doctor's lock check included); a Release dry run on the branch passes the build and smoke-test job

outcomes.change: The pin hand-off adds the subdirectory only for refs newer than v0.12.1
outcomes.checked_by: tests that a pin at v0.12.1 hands off to `git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@COMMIT` and a pin at a newer tag to `...@COMMIT#subdirectory=packages/kmctl`, for the command and the not-installed notice alike; the real uvx hand-off integration test pins `tree_repo`'s test-only tag (newer than v0.12.1, different from the running version) and runs the copy's kmctl from `packages/kmctl`

outcomes.change: Every install line, hint and the release tooling install from packages/kmctl
outcomes.checked_by: `scripts/release.py set` keeps the `#subdirectory=packages/kmctl` fragment on every line it pins

outcomes.change: The knowledge bundle, docs and local rules cite the moved paths, and a new ADR records the move
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl review due` reports no "source not resolved" notice; `kmctl check` and the strict okf-validate hook pass; historical records (`.okf/log.md`, `.okf/prototypes/`, eval results) keep their text

problems.text: kmctl's package (`pyproject.toml`, `src/kmctl/`, its tests) sits at the repository root, so the root is both the workspace and a package, unlike `packages/kmaudit` and the operator's uv-monorepo layout; and the pieces that would have to move with it assume the root: the `parents[2]` fallbacks to `apm/` in `src/kmctl/plugin.py`, `src/kmctl/antigravity.py` and `src/kmctl/opencode.py`, both release workflows' bare `uv build`, `scripts/check_wheel.py`'s default root `pyproject.toml`, and the `kmctl-check` hook that installs the root

Every install line and install hint names the root as kmctl's source (docs, `README.md`, the hook hints, `HOOK_INSTALL`, the release notes template, the starter justfile, `action.yml`), and `scripts/release.py`'s install pattern would drop a `#subdirectory=` fragment, so each breaks once the package moves
`src/kmctl/pin.py` hands off to a uvx source with no subdirectory, which cannot install a post-move release
The knowledge bundle and the repo's own rules cite the old paths: `.okf/` `sources[].resource`, the summary, overview and manifesto, docs pages, and the `paths:` globs of local `.claude/rules/`
